CAMDEN, N.J.–(BUSINESS WIRE)–Nov. 17, 2026– The Board of Directors of **The Campbell’s Company (NASDAQ:CPB) (Campbell’s)** today declared a regular quarterly dividend on the company’s capital stock of $0.25 per share. The quarterly dividend is payable February 8, 2027, to shareholders of record at the close of business as of January 14, 2027.


**About The Campbell’s Company**


For more than 155 years, The Campbell’s Company (NASDAQ:CPB) has been connecting people through food they love. Headquartered in Camden, N.J. since 1869, generations of consumers have trusted Campbell’s to provide delicious and affordable food and beverages. Today, the company is a North American focused brand powerhouse, generating fiscal 2026 net sales of $9.7 billion across two divisions: Meals & Beverages and Snacks. For more information, visit[www.thecampbellscompany.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.thecampbellscompany.com&esheet=54642851&newsitemid=20261117657433&lan=en-US&anchor=www.thecampbellscompany.com&index=1&md5=fff77abcd257983021b60ae11bba6fb6) .
